model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of blanks and accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "# Blanks" and displays integer values from 1 to 6, with tick labels present at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and ranges from 0 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 20. A single blue line with a solid style and circle markers is present. The line begins at a value of approximately 61% when # Blanks is 1, declines to approximately 22% when # Blanks is 2, then decreases further to approximately 15% when # Blanks is 3. Subsequently, the line decreases to around 10% when # Blanks is 4, remains at approximately 6% when # Blanks is 5, and settles at approximately 3% when # Blanks is 6.
